title: `SweepPassRecord` retains only per-category outcomes plus an uncategorized count, yet the benchmark reuses it
text: `SweepPassRecord` retains only per-category outcomes plus an uncategorized count, yet the benchmark reuses it. That cannot attribute each sweep-on unexpected finding to its category/categories/uncategorized as AC9 requires. Specify a per-finding attribution mapping in the record/output and tests.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 194f66e, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
